paragraphs.source_en: This was a corner of the Shiomi residence in Kariya Castle, where Odai had lived for fourteen years before her marriage. The murmur of the pines and the sea sounded just as it had before, but the atmosphere within the castle had changed completely. Her father was dead, and his former retainers had been ruthlessly expelled by her elder half brother, Nobumoto. Nobumoto had instituted reforms of every kind, seeking to eradicate the last traces of their father's influence.

paragraphs.source_en: In the blink of an eye, nearly half a year had passed since Odai left Okazaki. Could she go on living if, with a sorrowful heart, she married into the house of a perfect stranger?
